verdicts.reason: I picked A as the better resize. A has a strong headline and a CTA grouped with the body copy, but it has three flaws to fix: the SOLSTICE logo is pushed to the far left and sits on the edge of the green circle, 'fizz' wraps onto its own line, and the CTA is crowded against the right edge. B does not hold together. The bottle is jammed against the left edge, the logo, headline and body copy each sit on a slightly different centre, the CTA is left-aligned on its own, 'lightly sweet.' wraps awkwardly, and the two circles float in an empty right side.
